About the Position

IBEC's IR-DRUG project recruits a predoctoral researcher within its Nanoprobes and Nanoswitches group. Applicants seek a four-year research contract through the shared FPI call and select this scientific project as their research preference. This PhD opening at Institute for Bioengineering of Catalonia (IBEC) centres on IBEC PhD: IR-DRUG Nanoprobes and Nanoswitches. Disciplinary scope: Bioengineering. The host institution is in Barcelona, Spain. This is a fully funded opportunity; financial support is listed as EUR 24,550 gross/year years 1–3; EUR 25,500 year 4. Applications close 20 October 2026.

Research Areas

  • Nanoprobes
  • Nanoswitches
  • Bioengineering

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryEUR 24,550 gross/year years 1–3; EUR 25,500 year 4
DurationFour-year predoctoral contract

The shared FPI call also provides mobility and training support; university enrolment fees are covered under the call conditions.

Eligibility and Requirements

By the stated intake date candidates must hold a university degree together with a master’s degree, or an official qualification from a European Higher Education Area country covering at least 300 ECTS credits. Applicants must not already hold a doctoral degree.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round20 October 2026
LocationSpain

About Institute for Bioengineering of Catalonia (IBEC)

IBEC is a bioengineering research institute in Barcelona. Its doctoral researchers work within research groups and enrol for the doctorate at a university; IBEC supplies the research environment and predoctoral contract.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Funding and call timetable: IBEC shared FPI call

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 20 October 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗

Application guides

  • How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps
  • Academic CV for PhD Applications: Structure and an Example

Official Link

https://ibecbarcelona.eu/es/predoctoral-researcher-at-the-nanoprobes-and-nanoswitches-research-group-ir-drug/

Important Notes

  • Always confirm the full requirements and current deadline on the official website before applying.
  • Prepare the requested documents early — competitive awards are often decided on complete, on-time submissions.
  • Funding terms shown here reflect the listing at the time of publication and can be updated by the provider.
